overall_assessment: The shared provider runtime architecture extracted from Sourceright into evidence-search-core, codified across crates/evidence-search-core/src/provider.rs, crates/evidence-search-core/src/lib.rs, crates/evidence-search-core/tests/subrequest_context.rs, crates/searchright-connectors/src/lib.rs, docs/provider-subrequest-context.md, and tests/test_shared_provider_runtime_governance.py establishes a disciplined execution kernel. In evidence-search-core, ProviderRegistry, ExecutionPolicy, and PageExecutionContext implement deterministic subrequest budgets, cancellation tokens, explicit shared rate groups, and bounded retry/timeout policies. Local validation demonstrates complete isolation of provider execution, while the non-negotiable boundaries (no unadmitted background requests, cooperative deadlines, and strict redaction) are fully preserved. Deterministic governance tests pass 100% network-free.
verified_invariants: Core provider kernel: ProviderRegistry, ExecutionPolicy, and PageExecutionContext enforce centralized execution bounds
Subrequest context safety: run_subrequest bounds cumulative child calls and respects cooperative cancellation
Shared rate groups: rate group registration prevents burst flooding across concurrent tasks

findings.description: Provider kernel contracts and local mock execution are verified; executing transport-level adversarial checks against live network infrastructure remains an open operational gate.
findings.recommendation: Preserve open gate for live transport-level adversarial evidence.

assertions_evaluated.notes: Retries, cache, endpoint, rate and receipt behavior in shared core runtime verified.

limitations: Shared provider runtime kernel verified with fixture and local mock tests; live provider execution remains opt-in only.
